# Psalm 89 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-maskil of-Ethan the-Ezrahite. The-steadfast-love-of YHWH forever I-will-sing; to-generation and-generation I-will-make-known your-faithfulness with-my-mouth.

**2** For I-said, 'Forever steadfast-love will-be-built; the-heavens you-establish your-faithfulness in-them.'

**3** 'I-have-made a-covenant with-my-chosen; I-have-sworn to-David my-servant:

**4** To-forever I-will-establish your-seed, and-I-will-build to-generation and-generation your-throne.' Selah.

**5** And-let-praise the-heavens your-wonders O-YHWH, also your-faithfulness in-assembly-of the-holy-ones.

**6** For who in-the-skies can-be-compared to-YHWH? Who-is-like YHWH among the-sons-of the-mighty?

**7** God feared in-council-of the-holy-ones greatly, and-awesome above all around-him.

**8** O-YHWH God-of hosts, who like-you mighty Yah? And-your-faithfulness surrounds-you.

**9** You rule the-surging-of the-sea; when-rise its-waves you-still-them.

**10** You crushed like-a-corpse Rahab; with-arm-of your-strength you-scattered your-enemies.

**11** To-you the-heavens, also to-you the-earth; the-world and-its-fullness you founded-them.

**12** North and-south you created-them; Tabor and-Hermon in-your-name shout-for-joy.

**13** To-you an-arm with-might; is-strong your-hand, is-exalted your-right-hand.

**14** Righteousness and-justice foundation-of your-throne; steadfast-love and-faithfulness go-before your-face.

**15** Blessed the-people knowing the-shout; O-YHWH in-light-of your-face they-walk.

**16** In-your-name they-rejoice all the-day, and-in-your-righteousness they-are-exalted.

**17** For the-glory-of their-strength you-are, and-in-your-favor is-exalted our-horn.

**18** For to-YHWH our-shield, and-to-the-Holy-One-of Israel our-king.

**19** Then you-spoke in-vision to-your-faithful-one and-said, 'I-have-placed help upon a-mighty-one; I-have-exalted a-chosen-one from the-people.

**20** I-have-found David my-servant; with-oil-of my-holiness I-have-anointed-him,

**21** With-whom my-hand will-be-established; also my-arm will-strengthen-him.

**22** Not will-exact-from-him the-enemy, and-son-of wickedness not will-oppress-him.

**23** And-I-will-crush before-him his-adversaries, and-those-hating-him I-will-strike.

**24** And-my-faithfulness and-my-steadfast-love with-him, and-in-my-name is-exalted his-horn.

**25** And-I-will-set on-the-sea his-hand, and-on the-rivers his-right-hand.

**26** He will-call-to-me, "My-father you-are, my-God and-rock-of my-salvation."

**27** Also I will-make-him firstborn, highest of-kings-of the-earth.

**28** Forever I-will-keep for-him my-steadfast-love, and-my-covenant is-faithful to-him.

**29** And-I-will-set to-forever his-seed, and-his-throne as-days-of heaven.

**30** If forsake his-sons my-law, and-in-my-judgments not they-walk,

**31** If my-statutes they-profane, and-my-commandments not they-keep,

**32** Then-I-will-punish with-a-rod their-transgression, and-with-stripes their-iniquity.

**33** But-my-steadfast-love not I-will-break from-him, and-not I-will-be-false in-my-faithfulness.

**34** Not I-will-profane my-covenant, and-utterance-of my-lips not I-will-alter.

**35** Once I-have-sworn by-my-holiness; if to-David I-will-lie!

**36** His-seed to-forever will-be, and-his-throne as-the-sun before-me.

**37** Like-the-moon it-will-be-established forever, and-a-witness in-the-sky faithful.' Selah.

**38** But-you have-rejected and-spurned; you-have-been-furious with your-anointed.

**39** You-have-renounced the-covenant-of your-servant; you-have-profaned to-the-ground his-crown.

**40** You-have-broken-down all his-walls; you-have-made his-fortifications a-ruin.

**41** Have-plundered-him all passing-of the-way; he-has-become a-reproach to-his-neighbors.

**42** You-have-exalted the-right-hand-of his-adversaries; you-have-made-rejoice all his-enemies.

**43** Also you-turn-back the-edge-of his-sword, and-not you-have-made-him-stand in-battle.

**44** You-have-brought-to-an-end his-splendor, and-his-throne to-the-ground you-have-cast.

**45** You-have-shortened the-days-of his-youth; you-have-covered-him shame. Selah.

**46** How-long O-YHWH? Will-you-hide-yourself to-perpetuity? Will-burn like-fire your-wrath?

**47** Remember I — what is-life-span? For-what vanity have-you-created all sons-of man?

**48** What man lives and-not sees death? Can-he-deliver his-soul from-hand-of Sheol? Selah.

**49** Where are-your-former steadfast-loves O-Lord, which you-swore to-David in-your-faithfulness?

**50** Remember O-Lord the-reproach-of your-servants; my-bearing in-my-bosom all the-many peoples,

**51** With-which have-reproached your-enemies O-YHWH, with-which they-have-reproached the-footsteps-of your-anointed.

**52** Blessed YHWH to-forever. Amen and-Amen.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **89:3-4**: The Davidic covenant — 'seed to-forever' and 'throne to-generation and-generation' — the most extensive covenant recitation in the Psalter.

- **89:14**: 'Righteousness and-justice foundation-of your-throne' — God's rule is structurally built on moral attributes.

- **89:38-51**: The devastating 'but' (ve'attah) — the contrast between covenant promise (vv. 1-37) and present reality (vv. 38-51) is the theological crisis of the psalm.

— EMET
